newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel prices jump with NYMEX, but diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel prices jump with NYMEX, but diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices rose sharply on Tuesday, propelled by soaring NYMEX futures markets, industry sources said.
But dealings on cash markets was subdued, and differentials continued to weaken, they said, with buyers still hard to find.
Gulf Coast aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was talked 0.25 cent below October NYMEX heating oil futures, players said.
Offers for York Harbor 54-grade jet eased to 2.25 cent a gallon over October NYMEX, players said.
API said U.S. jet fuel stocks rose by 798,000 barrels last week to 41.2 million barrels, despite a drop in imports and production.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
